name: Scott's Tweaks
description: Scott's organized gameplay menu: selectable Crystal/Battle Art Gen 1-5 sprites, native-pixel Pocket Bag and responsive PC skins, four-card Pokegear, Buddy/All EXP.SHARE, independent trainer/boss/wild difficulty, Trade Stone, trainer forfeits and rematches, Oak's spare starter, B-button running, badge-free field moves, visible wild Pokemon, followers, Free Fly, and automatic physical-Thor dual-screen control. The built-in Kanto voxel renderer adds 3D exploration, smooth first-person trainer focus, pixel battle-entry wipes, staged battles with animated EXP, ceilings, horizons and weather.
